verdict.rationale: Cekura documents a first-party Python Metric that lets users write custom evaluation logic in Python to score agent calls, which directly delivers code-based custom scorers. Rubrics add custom threshold rules that combine multiple metrics. Missing for 10: documentation of the Python metric's input/output contract, execution environment and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that custom code scorers work as described.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can write custom code-based scorers and metrics for my evaluations

citations.quote: Python Metric allows you to write custom evaluation logic in Python to evaluate your AI agent's performance.
Write custom evaluation logic in Python to evaluate your AI agent's performance with complete control
you can create custom rules based on multiple metrics, set specific thresholds, and combine conditions with AND/OR logic.
